items.title: Your Guide to AWS for Telecom at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: The AWS for Telecom team invites you to join us at re:Invent in Las Vegas, NV, from November 30 to December 4, 2026. This year’s telecom track is built around interactive, hands-on sessions. Our lineup focuses on the real-world challenges telecom operators face today, so you leave with your questions answered and ready to move projects forward.
items.creator: Peter McKiernan
